headline: Only 3.6% of Chinese model releases published safety tests
body: A SemiAnalysis study reported by the FT found Chinese developers published safety evaluations for just 3.6% of 857 model releases, arguing Beijing will not 'pace the frontier'. That weakens both Alignment & Control and Global Coordination, lifting Conquerors and Zookeeper. Capability kept rising too: Meta released Muse Wonder, its first frontier-class model, and BloombergNEF projected China will spend $3.9T through 2049 moving power to AI data centres. Police use of Graylark's Raven, which can locate a home from one interior photo, added to Surveillance & Control. Horizon Balance fell to -13.69.
movers_note: Conquerors +0.3 (safety-test study +0.17, Muse Wonder +0.09, China grid +0.06), Zookeeper +0.3 (+0.12, +0.09 and +0.06) and Reversion -0.2 (Muse Wonder -0.11, China grid -0.08).
